BFA.note: A datacentre built under the land project is not stated to rent capacity to others.

facts.fact: The PARGFM land-component coordinator told leFaso.net that development and deployment of a national land information system is in progress, with land services of 20 communes interconnected ahead of it.
The PARGFM land-component coordinator said a national land information system is being developed and deployed, with a pilot of systematic registration of land rights under way.
The PARGFM coordinator said the land services of 20 communes were interconnected ahead of the land information system, in a project covering 51 communes.

BFA.note: Who pays for the connection and what the offices do over it are not stated.
No nationally owned data centre for hire stated.
